sandbox-city.title: Sandbox City - Explore, Drive, and Survive the Zombie Apocalypse
sandbox-city.description: Step into Sandbox City, a thrilling zombie survival game where you can freely explore and drive around the city. Be cautious of the zombie infection! Find and eliminate the zombies before the infection spreads. Sandbox City offers a unique blend of action, strategy, and survival. Ready to take on the challenge? Play Sandbox City now!
